title: II: The Marketplace

teacherSummary.text: Hester Prynne leaves the prison carrying her three-month-old baby, with a scarlet A elaborately embroidered in gold thread on her dress. Harsh women in the crowd say she deserves branding or death. She stands on the scaffold for three hours, remembering her past in England and her marriage to an older scholar, and clutches the baby to her breast.
